hypothesis_title: Iter 31 — STR_1701 Hyperparameter Grid Search Tuning (4-dim sweep)
hypothesis_description:
Iter 31 — 사용자 mandate: STR_1701 자체 그리드 서치 튜닝. PG2 레벨 X, 1701 strategy hyperparameter 단위.

## 동기 (사용자 mandate)
- 16 sprint cycle 모두 단일 point 평가 (각 mutation 1개 design)
- 본 sprint = STR_1701 hyperparameter 4 차원 grid sweep
- 최적 hyperparameter 조합 발견 시 Iter 11 baseline 1.291 standalone 능가 가능성

## Grid Search 4차원 (5×5×3×3 = 225 combinations)

### Dimension 1: Linear Tilt λ
- {0.5, 0.8, 1.0 (Iter 11 default), 1.2, 1.5}
- alpha tilt 강도 (낮으면 EW 가까움, 높으면 high-alpha concentrated)

### Dimension 2: TOphi (turnover penalty)
- {3, 5, 8 (Iter 11 default), 12, 15}
- turnover 비용 vs alpha activation trade-off

### Dimension 3: Cash overlay NORMAL%
- {0%, 5% (Iter 11), 10%}
- 평시 cash 보유 비율

### Dimension 4: Cash overlay (CAUTION%, CRISIS%)
- {(10%, 20%), (15%, 30%) (Iter 11), (20%, 40%)}
- 위기 시 cash hedge 강도

## 평가 (per combination)
- walk-forward SR / CAGR / MDD / Vol
- AX-001 v2 4-metric (crisis_alpha + Core MDD relief + bad/normal IC ratio + Harvey conditional)
- Hard caps PASS (TO ≤ 600%, MDD ≤ 45%, CVaR_d ≤ 2.5%)
- Per-regime SR (BULL/NORMAL/CAUTION)

## Best Selection
- Primary: max(realized SR) AND pass_to AND pass_mdd AND pass_cvar
- Tie-breaker: AX-001 v2 PASS count + DSR_post
- Top 3 → Forge realized backtest (decisive)

## 19 sprint 학습 BLOCKING
- L-220~238 모두 적용
- alpha_inheritance_hash: STR_1701 cor ≥ 0.95 strict (Iter 14/24 silent override 학습)
- 92-date 직접 calibration (L-238 fix)
- single-overlay 회피 — multi-dim grid
